user.title: Connect to Housecairn
user.description: Create an API token in Housecairn (More, Me, API tokens), bound to the home to show. Give it the Read right to see the tasks, and Read and Write to also mark them Done and report problems from Home Assistant. Home Assistant calls Housecairn with this token; Housecairn never receives a Home Assistant token.

data_description.api_token: Starts with hc_. It is stored in this configuration entry only.
data_description.verify_ssl: Leave on unless the certificate is one you trust and Home Assistant does not.

home.title: Choose the home
home.description: This token is bound to several homes. Each home is added on its own; add the next one by setting up the integration again.

reauth_confirm.title: New token for {home}
reauth_confirm.description: Housecairn refused the token: it has expired, was revoked, or is no longer bound to this home. Create a new token in Housecairn (More, Me, API tokens), bound to this home, with the Read right, and the Write right to mark tasks Done.

reauth_sso.title: New token for {home}
reauth_sso.description: {home} requires signing in through a sign-in provider, and the saved token does not carry it: it was created in a session that was not signed in through that provider, or an owner changed the provider the home requires. In Housecairn, open More, Me, API tokens, Create a token: next to this home, use Continue with and the name of the provider, then tick the home. Give the new token the Read right, and the Write right to mark tasks Done.

read_only.title: Read-only token
read_only.description: This token can read {home} but cannot change it: the to-do list is shown but tasks cannot be marked Done from Home Assistant, and the Report action is refused. To allow it, create a token with the Read and Write rights in Housecairn (More, Me, API tokens) and set up the integration again. Continue to add the home read-only.

reauth_read_only.title: Read-only token
reauth_read_only.description: The new token works but cannot change {home}: tasks cannot be marked Done from Home Assistant until a token with the Read and Write rights is saved. Continue to save it anyway.

error.invalid_url: Enter an http or https address, without query or credentials.
error.cannot_connect: Housecairn could not be reached at this address.
error.ssl_error: The TLS certificate of the server was refused.
error.invalid_auth: Housecairn refused the token: it is invalid, expired or revoked.
error.insufficient_scope: The token does not have the Read right.
error.no_homes: The token is not bound to any home.
error.home_locked: This home requires signing in through a sign-in provider, and the token was not created in a session signed in through it. In Housecairn, use Continue with next to the home on the New API token screen, then create the token.
error.wrong_home: The token is not bound to this home.

abort.probe_failed: Housecairn could not tell what this token may do. Try again.

home_locked.message: This home requires signing in through a sign-in provider that the token does not carry.

occurrence_gone.message: {task} is no longer in the list: it was done, skipped or removed in Housecairn. The list has been refreshed.

already_closed.message: {task} was already marked done or skipped in Housecairn. The list has been refreshed.

completion_refused.message: Housecairn refused to mark {task} done. The list has been refreshed.

write_scope_missing.message: The Housecairn token does not have the Write right: tasks cannot be marked Done. Create a token with the Read and Write rights and set up the integration again.

only_done.message: Housecairn lists can only mark a task done, or take back a Done, from Home Assistant; change anything else in Housecairn.

sso_required.message: This home requires signing in through a sign-in provider that the token does not carry (it was created outside a session of that provider, or the provider changed). Home Assistant asks for a new token.

already_reopened.message: {task} is not marked done in Housecairn any more. The list has been refreshed.

undo_refused.message: Housecairn refused to take back the Done of {task}: the next time this task is due has been changed since. Change it in Housecairn. The list has been refreshed.

report_needs_write.message: The Housecairn token of {home} does not have the Write right: it cannot report a problem. Create a token with the Read and Write rights and enter it in the integration.

report.name: Report a problem
report.description: Reports a problem in a home of Housecairn, as the person who owns the token. Nothing is created when a report of that person with the same title and the same place is not closed yet. Needs a token with the Write right.

config_entry_id.name: Home
config_entry_id.description: The Housecairn home to report the problem in.

title.name: Title
title.description: What is wrong, in 200 characters at most.

room.name: Room
room.description: Identifier of a room of the home, to say where. At most one of room, item and stock item.

item.name: Item
item.description: Identifier of an item of the home, to say where.

article.name: Stock item
article.description: Identifier of a stock item of the home, to say which.
